blocking_findings.title: /courses still ships the IICRC discipline-acronym map after the claimed fix
blocking_findings.quoted_line: | 18 | `/courses` carries an interactive **"IICRC Discipline Map"** whose seven nodes are the discipline acronyms, and an FAQ answer advising which IICRC discipline to choose | No default — removing or reframing a feature on the flagship commercial page is a product and SEO decision, not a copy fix. Agents fixed the copy that branded CARSI's own range; this is what remains. | 2026-08-22 | OPEN |
blocking_findings.reproduction: Confirmed in the post-image. `app/(public)/courses/page.tsx` still imports `IICRCDisciplineMap`, renders the section heading `IICRC Discipline Map`, renders `<IICRCDisciplineMap />`, and keeps the FAQ answer that spells out WRT/CRT/ASD/AMRT/FSRT/OCT/CCT via `AcronymTooltip`. `src/components/lms/diagrams/IICRCDisciplineMap.tsx` defines the seven node labels as WRT, CRT, ASD, OCT, CCT, FSRT and AMRT. `src/components/ui/AcronymTooltip.tsx` renders `{children ?? term}`, so those acronyms reach the DOM. I then ran `npm run check:iicrc-terminology` and `npm run check:iicrc-compliance`; both exited 0, proving the source guards still miss this rendered public surface.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Do not release while this is OPEN. Either remove/reframe the `/courses` discipline map and FAQ into CARSI topic/designation language, or obtain explicit founder approval and update the licence rules/guard strategy before release. A source-line regex cannot discharge this because the offending rendered copy is assembled through JSX components.

blocking_findings.title: The changed Terms page still asserts IICRC-approved courses and reporting with an empty CEC registry
blocking_findings.quoted_line: | 17 | `/terms` §5 states courses ARE IICRC-approved for CECs and that CARSI reports completions to the IICRC; §4 describes only subscriptions; §1 says "ABN to be confirmed" | No default — a published contract. Agents drafted the Refund Policy it now links to, but will not rewrite the Terms themselves. | 2026-08-24 | OPEN |
blocking_findings.reproduction: The branch edits `app/(public)/terms/page.tsx` to add a Refund Policy link in section 4, but section 5 remains live: `Certain courses are approved by the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC) for Continuing Education Credits (CECs).`, `You must achieve a minimum passing score (typically 80%) to earn CECs.`, and `CARSI reports CEC completions to IICRC on your behalf.` I ran `env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TERM=dumb npm run check:cec`; it exited 0 with `CEC approvals registry valid — 0 entries (0 approved).` The diff itself records this as an OPEN published-contract issue.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Do not release a Terms-page change while the same page still carries unresolved licence-critical CEC approval/reporting assertions. Rewrite section 5 to fail closed against `data/seed/cec-approvals.json`, or hold the release until the founder resolves DECISIONS #17.
